bullets.source_text: Built Python and SQL checks for a synthetic sales dataset containing 12000 rows, flagging duplicate records before analysis.
Analyzed weekly trends with pandas and documented missing-value handling so another student could reproduce the report.
Created visualizations comparing regional order volume and explained the limits of the synthetic data to a class team.
Used Git to track analysis changes and wrote setup instructions for a reproducible local Python environment.
Cleaned 8 synthetic CSV tables with Python and checked joins against documented record counts.
Wrote SQL summaries of order totals and reconciled results with spreadsheet calculations before sharing findings.
Documented data definitions and known missing fields to prevent the class team from treating missing observations as zero.
Compared regression baselines on a synthetic time series using a chronological train and test split to avoid leakage.
Evaluated prediction errors by week with scikit-learn and documented where the baseline performed poorly.
Packaged feature preparation and model evaluation in a reproducible Python script with a fixed random seed.
Built a Python command-line tool that validates schemas, missing values and duplicate keys in fictional order data.
Added regression checks for malformed rows and produced a readable report of validation failures.
Documented SQL examples for investigating failed joins and retained small synthetic fixtures for repeatable testing.
